_doc: Backgrounds (T-0075, docs/design/character-and-appearance.md): where the player's life starts. cash/bank: starting money in euro cents; job: a job id the player starts in ("" = none); skills: skill id -> starting level; knows: how many neighbours already know the player (acquaintances, both ways); moodlet: optional, how it feels at the start; record: a criminal record (kept for M4). default: the background a character gets without a choice. Content rules (AGENTS.md) apply to every line.

backgrounds.name: Newcomer
backgrounds.description: Just moved to the Altstadt for an office job. Some savings, knows nobody.

backgrounds.name: Local
backgrounds.description: Grew up here and works at the warehouse. Knows a few neighbours, modest savings.

backgrounds.name: Student
backgrounds.description: Studies in the city and lives cheaply. Little money, no job yet, good with logic.

backgrounds.name: Ex-con
backgrounds.description: Just released. Almost no money, no job, and a record that will follow you.

backgrounds.name: Burnout
backgrounds.description: Quit a corporate job before it broke you. Savings, office skills, and very tired.
